survey: A green open trough descends from the raised yellow platform, curves around the blue support columns, and ends over the pool with water flowing out. The columns attach beneath the platform and slide and rest on broad feet on the tiled deck. Diagonal braces support the platform. The blue ladder rests on the deck and reaches the platform, with curved handrails extending above it. Yellow guardrails attach to the platform perimeter. The slide opening and ladder face the camera.
